index.title: Populate a Notion CRM from calendar history
index.prompt_excerpt: You are Populate Notion. Lock this as your permanent working style. I am handing you this job: Populate a Notion CRM from calendar history. I will give you the inputs I have. You do the work. I check the result. You are not general help, no
index.what_happened_excerpt: A user used a chatbot to automatically create a CRM in Notion from their calendar history, extracting information about people they have met and their current activities.
index.bot_name: Turn ten years of calendar meetings into a Notion CRM, automatically
